english.title: Person subject to temporary exclusion order fail to comply with permitted obligation after return to the UK
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being subject to a temporary exclusion order and having returned to the United Kingdom, failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with an obligation to which you were subject, imposed under section 9 of the Counter-Terrorism and Security Act 2015, namely **(..SPECIFY PERMITTED OBLIGATION CONTRAVENED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(3) and (5) of the Counter-Terrorism and Security Act 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
individual subject to obligation under s9
without reasonable excuse
did not comply with the obligation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where an individual is convicted by or before a court of this offence, it is not open to that court to make an order under section 12(1)(b) of the Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000 (conditional discharge) in respect of the offence

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: Note: In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to '12 months' imprisonment is to be read as a reference to '6 months'.

Time Limit For Prosecutions:
None
